records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for setting up Pioneer Media on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Pioneer Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 and 1 invite sent show early momentum, but no key milestone by day 6 and no reply to onboarding outreach [email:429a9778]. Starter, no tickets, no engagement signals; 8 days left leaves some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Next step for Pioneer Media in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Nice work getting your first project set up and an invite out to a teammate last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, adding the first few tasks is usually where Wrenfield starts to click for a team.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you map your current workflow into that first project. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
